name: motion-probe-monorepo
description: Agent-friendly animation verification for React Native: native UI-layer probe + CLI + JSON reports.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @motion-probe/core && npm run build -w @motion-probe/cli && npm run build -w @motion-probe/mcp
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json --noEmit
